name: How does a garage conversion affect parking and property value?

mainEntity.name: How does a garage conversion affect parking and property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting your garage may affect available parking on your property, especially if it eliminates off-street parking. Local zoning ordinances in areas like Las Vegas often have specific requirements for off-street parking, which must be considered. In terms of property value, a well-executed garage conversion that adds functional, high-quality living space generally increases your home's market value, often providing a good return on investment. The impact on value is maximized when the conversion is permitted and professionally done.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion can impact parking, requiring compliance with local ordinances. However, a high-quality, permitted conversion typically increases property value and offers good ROI.
